description: Run `stage.sh test-combined` on the branch head (reversal + app split + flow) | Acceptance: GIVEN branch head pulled on the VPS WHEN `stage.sh test-combined` runs THEN the result line reads `0 failed, 0 error(s) of N` with N above the previous 189, and the full output is pasted into DEPLOY_LOG

Run `stage.sh rehearse-upgrade` (copy of staging) | Acceptance: GIVEN OPS-001 green WHEN the rehearsal runs THEN verdict is PASSED, five app roots are listed and no leftover shared Pharma root exists; staging database untouched

Owner-approved `stage.sh upgrade` then `verify` and `smoke` | Acceptance: GIVEN a named go WHEN the upgrade runs THEN module versions match the manifests, hardening endpoint is still disabled, courier crons active = 0, smoke reports all apps and menus, counts unchanged, a dump path is printed

Browser check: apps in the switcher, support button gone after hard refresh | Acceptance: GIVEN a hard-refreshed browser WHEN logged in as admin THEN five pharma apps with icons show and no vendor support button appears

Owner browser pass of scenarios C1-C17 as each login | Acceptance: GIVEN each demo login WHEN the presenter script C1-C17 is run THEN every expected result is observed or a defect is logged; sign-off with date

Company scope: decide, then enforce | Acceptance: GIVEN two companies in one database WHEN a user of company A requests a company-B parcel, remittance, entry or exception by id through RPC THEN access is refused; OR a signed single-entity decision exists AND a test proves the module refuses a second company

Review exception write surface; add Auditor role and SoD matrix | Acceptance: GIVEN an Operations user WHEN they write any exception field other than ownership/notes THEN it is refused; GIVEN an Auditor WHEN they open any pharma record THEN they can read and cannot write, post or approve

Register every `sudo()`: justification, pre-check, negative test | Acceptance: GIVEN the 33 `sudo()` call sites WHEN reviewed THEN each has a one-line reason, a permission check on the real user before it, and a test where an unauthorized user is refused

Audit trail for process mode, courier accounts and authorized deductions | Acceptance: GIVEN a change to `pharma.cod_flow_mode`, a courier account or authorized deductions WHEN saved THEN who/when/old/new is logged and `stage.sh verify` prints the current mode

Money fields to Monetary with currency (non-destructive migration) | Acceptance: GIVEN existing data WHEN migrated THEN every total is identical before and after, `currency_id` defaults to the company currency, and a mixed-currency entry is refused

CI job running pharma Odoo tests and the reserved-name scan | Acceptance: GIVEN a pull request WHEN CI runs THEN it installs the pharma module list on a throwaway DB and fails the build on any test failure or reserved-attribute shadowing
Reference transaction: COD lead-to-cash verified end to end | Acceptance: See §2 (GIVEN/WHEN/THEN suite)

Localization and period-lock policy (Pakistan chart or documented alternative) | Acceptance: GIVEN the approved chart and lock policy WHEN an accountant posts into a locked period THEN it is refused; the accountant-signed posting catalog covers every COD event
Automate reconciliation checks REC-1..8 | Acceptance: GIVEN seeded and live-like data WHEN the checks run THEN each returns 0 variance, or lists the exact records; a failure fails the test run

Lots, expiry (FEFO), recall report for pharma stock | Acceptance: GIVEN two lots with different expiry WHEN a delivery reserves THEN the earlier-expiring lot is picked; an expired lot cannot be delivered; a recall by lot lists every customer shipment

Procure-to-pay slice verified (PO, partial receipt, bill, payment) | Acceptance: GIVEN a PO of 10 WHEN 6 are received then billed then paid THEN receipt, bill, payment and GL entries link at line level and reconcile; AP subledger equals the control account

Bank statement import and automatic matching to remittances | Acceptance: GIVEN a bank file WHEN imported twice THEN the second import adds nothing; a credit with the slip reference matches its remittance; an unmatched credit becomes an exception
Freight validation against rate cards | Acceptance: GIVEN a courier rate card WHEN a slip deducts freight above the expected amount THEN a finding names the parcel and the excess

Returned-parcel COD refund and tax-event reversal | Acceptance: GIVEN a returned parcel with COD collected WHEN processed THEN a draft refund entry exists, the original tax event is reversed (never edited), and the parcel shows settled

Metric dictionary and role dashboards with lineage | Acceptance: GIVEN a dashboard tile WHEN clicked THEN it opens the exact records behind the figure; the tile has a dictionary entry (formula, source, owner)

Audit existing AI add-ons against blueprint §12 | Acceptance: GIVEN each agent WHEN audited THEN scoped identity, tool allow-list, approval for any write, kill switch and evaluation set are present or logged as gaps

Tests for money-moving platform add-ons (billing, e-invoicing, CFO, ZAKI) | Acceptance: GIVEN each add-on WHEN its suite runs THEN happy, failure, duplicate and permission paths pass; coverage of money paths is reported
Decouple CFO and platform families through an adapter | Acceptance: GIVEN the manifests WHEN analysed THEN no family depends on another in both directions
Integration contracts INT-01..07 on the pack template | Acceptance: GIVEN each integration WHEN documented THEN identity, idempotency, retry, DLQ and tests are filled; no row says TBD

Complete the data dictionary's business columns, pharma first | Acceptance: GIVEN the as-built CSV WHEN reviewed THEN company scope, security class, roles, editable states and test id are filled for every pharma field
Module specs per module on the pack template | Acceptance: GIVEN a pharma add-on WHEN reviewed THEN it has a signed MODULE_SPEC with requirements and tests
